Name: The Flight Before Christmas
Overview:
In The Flight Before Christmas, Santa Claus automatically rides his sleigh over the roofs of a city. His job: delivering all presents via chimney express. There are four presents available which are thrown by pressing the associated buttons. It is not only required to press the button with the correct timing, each chimney also requires to deliver a specific present.

The overall goal is to earn as many points as possible before the time limit runs out. These are obviously rewarded for correct deliveries (a combo is built up when not missing any shots), but points are removed for delivering the wrong present or not hitting a chimney. Santa's sled has an optional spotlight which shows when to press the button. However, using it has a point penalty.
